svg.title: After 8 of the 36 layers, Quill and Ember read each other at the same time
svg.desc: Quill and Ember drawn as two stacks of 36 layers, with the input at the base and the head at the top. After layers 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 27 two teal strands join the stacks, one per direction: each model reads the other from the states before that exchange and adds the result to its own residual stream. A zoom on layer 9 shows the read in three steps. Schematic; counts from pairing/link.py and the model configs.
